extraction_notes: Forward, reverse, capacitance, and power curves were sampled directly from the plotted traces in p. 2 after converting plotted mA, microA, pF, and mW axes to A, F, and W; no intermediate points were interpolated.
Electrical table values retain the published maximum or typical bound and test conditions. Maximum forward voltage is 0.25 V at IF=0.1mA, 0.45 V at IF=10mA, and 1.0 V at IF=250mA.
Maximum reverse current table entries are 0.3 microA at VR=1.5V, 0.5 microA at VR=10V, 1.0 microA at VR=50V, and 2.0 microA at VR=75V, all at Ta=25 degC unless otherwise noted.

Maximum ratings on p. 1 include VRRM=100 V, VRMS=100 V, VDC=100 V, IF(AV)=0.15 A, IFSM=0.35 A at t=8.3ms half-sine wave, PD=200 mW, Tj=-55 to +150 degC, TSTG=-55 to +150 degC, and RthetaJA=500 degC/W.
The datasheet publishes no reverse-recovery-time or breakdown-voltage electrical-characteristics entries; reverse recovery and breakdown fields are null.
The plotted curves are typical characteristics and the digitized values are approximate readings from the graph axes; they are not table bounds.
